questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different initial consonant sound (/p/ vs /b/).
questions.explanation_vi: /b/ in basketball; /p/ in the other three words.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different initial consonant sound (/p/ vs /b/).
questions.explanation_vi: /p/ in polite; /b/ in the other three words.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different initial consonant sound (/p/ vs /b/).
questions.explanation_vi: /b/ in book; /p/ in the other three words.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different initial consonant sound (/p/ vs /b/).
questions.explanation_vi: /p/ in patient; /b/ in the other three words.

questions.stem_text: Look! Mia _____ a portrait of her best friend.
questions.explanation_vi: Look! → present continuous: is drawing.

questions.stem_text: My best friend usually _____ others, but today she _____ for a competition.
questions.explanation_vi: Routine (usually) → helps + temporary action (today) → is preparing.

questions.stem_text: Which sentence describes personality rather than appearance?
questions.explanation_vi: Generous is a personality adjective; the others describe physical appearance.

questions.stem_text: James never forgets a promise. He is very _____.
questions.explanation_vi: Reliable means someone others can trust.

questions.stem_text: Hoa has _____ hair and _____ eyes.
questions.explanation_vi: Adjective order: length + colour + hair (long black); size + colour + eyes (big brown).

questions.stem_text: Quiet, please! The students _____ for a speaking test.
questions.explanation_vi: Happening now (Quiet, please!) → are preparing.

questions.stem_text: What _____ your new classmate _____ like?
questions.explanation_vi: What does ... look like? asks about appearance (singular subject → does + look).

questions.stem_text: "What _____ Nam like?" – "He is kind and patient."
questions.explanation_vi: What is ... like? asks about personality.

questions.stem_text: Our monitor is very _____; she checks every answer twice.
questions.explanation_vi: Careful fits checking work twice.

questions.stem_text: I cannot talk now. I _____ my cousin with his project.
questions.explanation_vi: Now → present continuous: am helping.

questions.stem_text: Find and correct the mistake: Look! Lan <u>plays</u> badminton with her new classmates now.
questions.explanation_vi: plays → is playing | Look!/now → present continuous.

questions.stem_text: Find and correct the mistake: She <u>is</u> long black hair and wears glasses.
questions.explanation_vi: is → has | We say: She has long black hair (not 'is').

questions.stem_text: Find and correct the mistake: "What <u>does</u> your best friend like?" – "She is kind and patient."
questions.explanation_vi: does → is | The answer describes personality: What is your best friend like?

questions.stem_text: Find and correct the mistake: At the moment, Tom and his friends <u>is</u> making a poster.
questions.explanation_vi: is → are | Plural subject (Tom and his friends) → are making.

questions.stem_text: Why did Linh speak so little in her first week?
questions.passage_or_sign_svg:
TEXT 1 | THE NEW CLASSMATE
There is a new girl in our class. Her name is Linh. She is short and has shoulder-length dark hair and bright eyes. During her first week, she hardly spoke to anyone. Some students thought she was unfriendly, but they were wrong. Linh later explained that she feels shy when she meets new people. She is very creative and patient. Last Friday, our group could not agree on a design for the class reading corner. Linh listened to everyone's ideas, drew a simple plan and helped us work together. This week she is painting a small welcome sign with two classmates. Now everyone wants to be in her group.
options: She felt shy with new people.
written_answers: She felt shy with new people.
signal_keywords: feels shy when she meets new people
questions.explanation_vi: She feels shy when meeting new people.

questions.stem_text: [Text 2 — T / F / NG] Bao feels comfortable when speaking in front of others.
questions.passage_or_sign_svg:
TEXT 2 | AN EMAIL FROM MINH
Dear Alex,
I am writing about my friend Bao. He has curly hair and usually wears glasses only when he reads. He is confident when he gives a talk, but he never shows off. He often helps younger students with their homework. At the moment, Bao and I are preparing a short presentation about healthy habits for our English club. We are practising after school every day this week. On Saturday, we hope to go hiking if the weather is fine.
See you soon,
Minh
signal_keywords: confident when he gives a talk
questions.explanation_vi: T (True) | Bao is confident when he gives a talk.

questions.stem_text: Write a complete sentence: Linh / have / long / straight / black hair / and / brown eyes.
options: Linh has long, straight black hair and brown eyes.
Linh have long, straight black hair and brown eyes.
Linh is having long straight black hair and brown eyes.
Linh has black straight long hair and brown eyes.
written_answers: Linh has long, straight black hair and brown eyes.
Linh has long straight black hair and brown eyes.
questions.explanation_vi: Linh has long, straight black hair and brown eyes. (Singular subject Linh → has; length + shape + colour).

questions.stem_text: Write a complete question: What / your best friend / look like / ?
options: What does your best friend look like?
What is your best friend look like?
What do your best friend look like?
What does your best friend looks like?
written_answers: What does your best friend look like?
questions.explanation_vi: What does your best friend look like? (Singular subject → auxiliary does + bare infinitive look).

questions.stem_text: Write a complete question: Why / they / make / a poster / at the moment / ?
options: Why are they making a poster at the moment?

Why is they making a poster at the moment?
written_answers: Why are they making a poster at the moment?
questions.explanation_vi: Why are they making a poster at the moment? (at the moment → Present Continuous question).

questions.stem_text: Write a complete sentence: Our class monitor / usually / help / new students / feel welcome.
options: Our class monitor usually helps new students feel welcome.
Our class monitor usually help new students feel welcome.
Our class monitor is usually helping new students feel welcome.
Our class monitor usually helps new students feeling welcome.
written_answers: Our class monitor usually helps new students feel welcome.
Our class monitor usually helps new students to feel welcome.
questions.explanation_vi: Our class monitor usually helps new students feel welcome. (usually → Present Simple; singular monitor → helps).

questions.stem_text: Write 70–90 words about a close friend. Include appearance, at least TWO personality traits with examples, what your friend is doing these days, and explain why this friendship matters to you.
options: My close friend is An. She has shoulder-length black hair and bright brown eyes. She is patient because she always explains difficult homework without getting angry. She is also creative and often draws funny pictures for our class. This week, she is designing a poster for the English club. We usually read books and play badminton together after school. I value our friendship because An listens to me and helps me feel confident when I try something new.
My friend is An. She is tall and nice. We play together every day.
An is my classmate. She has black hair. She likes English.
My best friend is very kind and friendly to everyone in class.
written_answers: My close friend is An. She has shoulder-length black hair and bright brown eyes. She is patient because she always explains difficult homework without getting angry. She is also creative and often draws funny pictures for our class. This week, she is designing a poster for the English club. We usually read books and play badminton together after school. I value our friendship because An listens to me and helps me feel confident when I try something new.
questions.explanation_vi: Rubric (1.5 pts): Task coverage & examples (0.4) | Grammar: present forms & agreement (0.4) | Vocabulary & adjectives (0.3) | Organisation & coherence (0.2) | Spelling & punctuation (0.2). Sample (78 words whitespace / 79 words hyphen-split).
